content.short: Altme Wallet is a specialized self-custodial wallet for managing decentralized identity and verifiable credentials.
content.description:
Altme Wallet is a leading decentralized identity (DID) manager and self-custodial digital wallet, designed to provide users with a secure and private gateway to the decentralized web. Built natively on the W3C verifiable credentials standard, the platform allows participants to manage their digital identity—such as age verification, reusable KYC, and diplomas—without ever disclosing their actual personal data to service providers. Altme serves as a primary hub for the European Blockchain Services Infrastructure (EBSI), ensuring that identity is a globally accessible and verifiable asset.

Operating as a multi-chain wallet, Altme supports a wide range of assets across networks including Ethereum, Polygon, and Tezos within a transparent and intuitive interface. The protocol focuses on professional-grade privacy and user sovereignty, ensuring that participants maintain total control over their private keys and credentials. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and technological innovation, Altme Wallet is building the essential framework for a more secure and inclusive digital future, where data ownership is a primary utility for mass adoption.
content.meta: Altme Wallet provides decentralized identity management and secure verifiable credential tools for the Web3 ecosystem.
